annotations.title: Wire cutoff times and Fedwire hours

description: Same-day wire cutoff times as each bank publishes them (latest first, Eastern time used for sorting), the Fedwire Funds Service operating hours, and the 2026 Federal Reserve holidays. Pass a date to learn whether it is a Fedwire business day and, if not, the next one. Pass a bank to get only its cutoffs.

bank.description: Optional bank name, e.g. "Wells Fargo". Omit for every bank.

date.description: Optional date in 2026 as YYYY-MM-DD, e.g. 2026-11-27, to check whether Fedwire is open that day.

name: get_wire_cutoff_times
title: Wire cutoff times and Fedwire hours
